name: scikit-learn
summary: AI-assisted code is accepted if the contributor has reviewed, understood and tested it and states AI use in the PR description. Fully automated issues and PRs are not accepted, and AI-generated text in descriptions and comments is not wanted beyond grammar help.

evidence.quote: Review all code or documentation changes made by AI tools and make sure you understand all changes and can explain them on request, before submitting them under your name.
If you used AI tools, you need to state so in your PR description.
Please refrain from submitting issues or pull requests generated by fully-automated tools.
Please do not paste AI generated text in the description of issues, PRs or in comments as this makes it harder for reviewers to assess your contribution.
We are happy for it to be used to improve grammar or if you are not a native English speaker.
